#Experiment
We induced hopping (transposition) in three clonal cell lines from Omar with the nested SB-in-PB. This experiment (E2902) contains SB hopping from the clones in two biological replicates (2xWT78, 2xWT79, 2xWT83) and mapping of the original PB integrations.


This script also contains:
- integrations site motifs (Figure 4)

In different scripts:
- correlation of integrations with contact
- correlation of transposition efficiency with chromatin

```{r load_libraries}
split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}
```

# Load SB hopped clones 

## PB clone and SB hopped pools
```{r}
MappingDataDir_E2902_SB <- "/DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_technology/E2913_mapping_integrations_E1845_E2866_E2902_and_others/pipeline_results/mm10/home/insertions/"

# List all files
metadata_E2902 <- tibble(file = dir(MappingDataDir_E2902_SB, 
                   recursive = T, full.names = T)) %>%
  # filter(grepl("insertions_ref", file)) %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), "\\..*"))


metadata_E2902_Omar = metadata_E2902 %>%
  filter(grepl("E2902", sample)) %>%
  #only take the PB clone and SB pool
  filter(!grepl("_[1,2]_PB", sample))

# Load all files
tib_ints_E2902_Omar <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(metadata_E2902_Omar),
                        function(i) {
                          tmp <- read_tsv(metadata_E2902_Omar$file[i],
                                          col_types = cols(
                                            .default = col_character(),
                                            start = col_double(),
                                            end = col_double(),
                                            # gap_concordance = col_double(),
                                            read_count = col_double(),
                                            mapq = col_double(),
                                            read_count_1 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_1 = col_character(),
                                            read_count_2 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_2 = col_character(),
                                            # sump = col_double(),
                                            # p_adj = col_double()
                                          )) %>%
                            mutate(sample = metadata_E2902_Omar$sample[i])
                        }))

tib_ints_E2902_Omar_annot = tib_ints_E2902_Omar %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl("PB", sample) ~ "PB_clone",
                          .default = "SB_pool"),
         replicate = case_when(grepl("_1_", sample) ~ "rep1", 
                               grepl("_2_", sample) ~ "rep2",
                               type == "PB_clone" ~ "rep1"), 
         )

```

## combine and filter
```{r}
tib_Omar_comb = tib_ints_E2902_Omar_annot%>%
  mutate(parental_clone = str_extract(sample, "WT[0-9]*"),
         mapped_arms = case_when(read_count_1 == 0 ~ "rv_only",
                                 read_count_2 == 0 ~ "fw_only",
                                 read_count_1 > 0 & read_count_2 > 0 ~ "both_arms"),
         chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chr)) #remove mitochondrial insertions and Tn5_plasmid insertions

tib_Omar_comb_PB_filt = tib_Omar_comb %>%
  filter(type == "PB_clone") %>%
  filter((read_count > 10 & read_count_1 > 1 & read_count_2 > 1))

tib_Omar_comb_SB_filt = tib_Omar_comb %>%
  filter(type == "SB_pool") # no readcount filtering, this mapping is not exhaustive


#cleanup env
rm(tib_Omar_comb, tib_ints_E2902_Omar_annot)
```

Make a tibble of the PB ints as reference
```{r}
tib_PB_ints = tib_Omar_comb_PB_filt %>%
  dplyr::select(parental_clone, chr, start, end) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(LP_name = paste0(parental_clone, "_", chr, "_", start))

# write_tsv(tib_PB_ints, '/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/02_Omar_clone_pools/rds/CM20260313_Omar_PB_ints_filtered.tsv')

tib_PB_ints= read_tsv('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/02_Omar_clone_pools/rds/CM20260313_Omar_PB_ints_filtered.tsv') %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))))

tib_PB_ints %>% 
  group_by(parental_clone) %>%
  summarize(n()) %>%

```



#Data quality
## Is it reasonable to filter for 1 read
```{r}
# number of insertions per chr
tib_Omar_comb_SB_filt %>%
  mutate(one_read = ifelse(read_count == 1, "one_read", "more_reads")) %>%
  mutate(one_read = factor(one_read, levels = c("one_read", "more_reads"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chr)) +  
  facet_grid(replicate + one_read ~ parental_clone, scales = 'free_y') + 
  geom_bar() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) 

#fraction of insertions per chr
tib_Omar_comb_SB_filt %>%
  mutate(one_read = ifelse(read_count == 1, "one_read", "more_reads")) %>%
  mutate(one_read = factor(one_read, levels = c("one_read", "more_reads"))) %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, replicate, one_read, chr) %>%
  summarize(N_ints = n()) %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, replicate, one_read) %>%
  mutate(fract_of_ints = N_ints/sum(N_ints)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chr, y = fract_of_ints)) +  
  facet_grid(replicate + one_read ~ parental_clone, scales = 'free_y') + 
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) 


tib_Omar_comb_SB_filt %>%
  mutate(one_read = ifelse(read_count == 1, "one_read", "more_reads")) %>%
  mutate(one_read = factor(one_read, levels = c("one_read", "more_reads"))) %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, replicate, one_read) %>%
  summarize(N_ints = n())
```

The distribution across chromosomes looks really similar when filtering for more reads or looking only at the one-read integrations (although a tiny bit more 'noise' on other chromosomes). So we can safely use the single read integrations
And filtering for only one read gives us >5x more integrations per replicate.

# Link SB to PB
```{r}
#get mouse genome seqinfo
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
seqinfo_mm10 <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)


parental_cell_lines = unique(tib_Omar_comb_PB_filt$parental_clone)

SB_linked_tib_ls = lapply(parental_cell_lines, function(cl){
  #make granges of the integrations
  parental_tib =  filter(tib_Omar_comb_PB_filt, parental_clone == cl & replicate == "rep1")
  parental_gr = parental_tib %>%
    GRanges(seqinfo = seqinfo_mm10)
  
  SB_tib = filter(tib_Omar_comb_SB_filt, parental_clone == cl) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(chr))
  SB_gr = SB_tib %>%
    GRanges(seqinfo = seqinfo_mm10)
  
  #find nearest
  nearest_idx <- GenomicRanges::nearest(SB_gr, parental_gr, ignore.strand = T)
  
  SB_tib_cl = SB_tib %>% 
    mutate(nearest_parental_idx = nearest_idx,
           nearest_parental_start = parental_tib$start[nearest_idx],
           dist_from_PB = start - nearest_parental_start,
           abs_dist_from_PB = abs(dist_from_PB))
})
 
tib_PB_ints_minimal = tib_PB_ints %>% dplyr::select(-end)
  
SB_linked_tib = bind_rows(SB_linked_tib_ls) %>%
  left_join(tib_PB_ints_minimal, by = join_by(nearest_parental_start == start, chr == chr,  parental_clone == parental_clone))

# saveRDS(SB_linked_tib, "/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/02_Omar_clone_pools/rds/CM20260330_PB_linked_filt_SB_ints_2reps.rds")
```

### local fraction
Which percentage is within 2Mb of a launch pad?
```{r}
fract_local_tib = SB_linked_tib %>% 
  mutate(local_hop = abs_dist_from_PB < distance_local_hop & !is.na(abs_dist_from_PB)) %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, replicate) %>%
  summarize(N_local_hop = sum(local_hop),
            fract_local_hop = sum(local_hop)/length(local_hop))
summary(fract_local_tib$fract_local_hop)

SB_linked_tib %>% 
  mutate(local_hop = abs_dist_from_PB < distance_local_hop & !is.na(abs_dist_from_PB)) %>%
  # group_by(parental_clone, replicate) %>%
  summarize(N_local_hop = sum(local_hop),
            fract_local_hop = sum(local_hop)/length(local_hop))
```
47% of integrations is within 2Mb of a LP, and this is consistent across replicates

## density on other chromosomes

What is the density of integrations on other chromosomes.


Manually curate the chromosomes without any integrations (so add the three clear densities of SB integrations that suggest we missed a PB integration there).
```{r}
visual_LPs = tibble(parental_clone = c("WT78", "WT78", "WT83"),
                    chr = c("chr1", "chr11", "chr17"))
chr_with_PB = tib_PB_ints %>%
  select(parental_clone, chr) %>%
  bind_rows(visual_LPs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(LP_present = TRUE)

SB_ints_per_chr = SB_linked_tib %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, chr) %>%
  summarise(N_ints = n())

SB_density_per_chr = expand_grid(parental_clone = c("WT78", "WT79", "WT83"),
            chr = paste0("chr", c(1:19,"X"))) %>%
  left_join(chr_with_PB) %>%
  replace_na(list(LP_present = FALSE)) %>%
  # filter(!LP_present) %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths) %>%
  left_join(SB_ints_per_chr) %>%
  mutate(density_chr = N_ints / length )

ggplot(SB_density_per_chr, aes(x = LP_present, y=density_chr, col = parental_clone)) +
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

SB_density_per_chr %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, LP_present) %>%
  summarize(total_length = sum(length),
            total_ints = sum(N_ints)) %>%
  mutate(total_density = total_ints/total_length) %>%
  mutate(ints_per_Mb = total_density * 1E6,
         ints_4Mb_region = total_density * 4E6)


SB_density_per_chr %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, LP_present) %>%
  summarize(total_length = sum(length),
            total_ints = sum(N_ints)) %>%
  mutate(total_density = total_ints/total_length) %>%
  mutate(ints_4Mb_region = total_density * 4E6) %>%
  filter(!LP_present) %>%
  dplyr::select(parental_clone, ints_4Mb_region) %>%
  kable()
```


# Calculate hopping efficiency

Count local integrations
```{r}
SB_linked_tib %>% 
  filter(abs_dist_from_PB <= distance_local_hop) %>%
  mutate(LP_name = paste0(parental_clone, "_", chr, "_", nearest_parental_start)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(replicate, parental_clone, LP_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())
```

Filter for local integrations

```{r}
SB_ints_per_PB_rep = 
  SB_linked_tib %>%
  filter(abs_dist_from_PB < distance_local_hop) %>% #only take the local hops
  group_by(replicate, parental_clone, chr, nearest_parental_idx,nearest_parental_start, ) %>%
  summarize(N_local_SB_ints = n(),
            median_dist = median(abs_dist_from_PB),
            mean_dist = mean(abs_dist_from_PB),
            N_within_10kb = sum(abs_dist_from_PB <= 10E3)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(start = nearest_parental_start) %>%
  left_join(tib_PB_ints) %>%
  #calculate number of hopped ints, relative to the mean of that parental clone
  #because pool size (number of mapped cells) as well as number of LPs differs between clones
  group_by(replicate, parental_clone) %>%
  mutate(rel_SB_ints_parental = N_local_SB_ints / mean(N_local_SB_ints)) 

# saveRDS(SB_ints_per_PB_rep, "/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/02_Omar_clone_pools/rds/CM20260330_SB_ints_per_PB_2reps.rds")


```

```{r 2C_SB_counts_per_LP}
SB_ints_per_PB_rep %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, LP_name) %>%
  summarize(total_ints = sum(N_local_SB_ints)) %>%
  summarize(min_ints = min(total_ints),
            max_ints = max(total_ints)) %>%
  mutate(fold_min_max = max_ints / min_ints) %>%
  kable()
```


# Motif insertion sites
For Figure 4A: what is the sequence motif of the SB integrations?

WHY does number of integrations change?
```{r 4A_motif_SB_insertions}
library(ggseqlogo)
#get GRanges of integrations
integration_coordinates_gr = SB_linked_tib %>%
  filter(strand != "*") %>%
  select(chr, start, strand) %>%
  mutate(end = start + 1) %>%
  GRanges() 

surrounding_ints_gr =  resize(integration_coordinates_gr, 14, fix = 'center')

Biostrings::getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, surrounding_ints_gr[1:10])

seqs_for_logo = as.character(Biostrings::getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, surrounding_ints_gr))

#for some reason the ggseqlogo cannot handle 500,000 sequences, so I just subsample to 200,000
ggseqlogo(seqs_for_logo[!grepl("N", seqs_for_logo)])
```

Is this motif completely independent on how it was mapped?
```{r S4B_motif_both_arms}
tib_seq_by_map = SB_linked_tib %>%
  filter(strand != "*") %>%
  mutate(seq = seqs_for_logo)

ggseqlogo(filter(tib_seq_by_map, mapped_arms == "both_arms" & !grepl("N", seq))$seq)
```

```{r S4B_motif_right_arm}
ggseqlogo(filter(tib_seq_by_map, mapped_arms == "fw_only" & !grepl("N", seq))$seq) #right arm

```

```{r S4B_motif_left_arm}
ggseqlogo(filter(tib_seq_by_map, mapped_arms == "rv_only" & !grepl("N", seq))$seq) #left arm
```


In the logo we see a preference for an extra flanking A (upstream) and T (downstream).
Do these specifically occur together, or is there just a preference for each separately?
And how often do they really occur?
```{r}

seqs_tib = tibble(seq = seqs_for_logo) %>%
  mutate(ins_site = substr(seq, 7,8),
         left_flank = substr(seq,4,4),
         right_flank = substr(seq,11,11))%>%
  mutate(flanks = case_when(left_flank == "A" & right_flank == "T" ~ 'both',
                            left_flank == "A" & right_flank != "T" ~ 'left_only',
                            left_flank != "A" & right_flank == "T" ~ 'right_only',
                            .default = 'none'
                            )) 

annots_logo = tibble(TA_site = TRUE,
  flanks = c("both", "left_only", "right_only", "none"),
                     motif = c("ANNTANNT",
                               "ANNTANNV",
                               "BNNTANNT",
                               "BNNTANNV"))

seqs_tib %>%
  mutate(TA_site = ins_site == "TA") %>%
  group_by(TA_site, flanks) %>%
  summarize(N = n()) %>%
  left_join(annots_logo) %>%
  group_by(TA_site)%>%
  mutate(fract = N / sum(N))

seqs_tib %>%
  mutate(TA_site = ins_site == "TA") %>%
  filter(TA_site)%>%
  group_by( flanks) %>%
  summarize(N = n()) %>%
  left_join(annots_logo) %>%
  mutate(fract = N / sum(N))
```
Turn this into a table for only the integrations with TA, 4 possible motifs, give fractions

Is both as expected from left and right only?
```{r}
seqs_tib %>%
  filter(ins_site == "TA") %>%
  summarize(f_left = sum(left_flank == "A")/n(),
            f_right = sum(right_flank == "T")/n(),
            expect_both = f_left * f_right * n(),
            obs_both = sum(left_flank == "A" & right_flank == "T"))


```
So observed both is slightly less than expected.

Sequence logo when there is no TA
```{r S4C_no_secondary_motif}
seqs_no_TA = seqs_tib %>%
  filter(ins_site != "TA") %>%
  filter(!grepl("N", seq)) %>%
  pull(seq) 

ggseqlogo(seqs_no_TA)

```

Confidence of integrations without a TA
```{r}
tib_seq_by_map %>%
  mutate(ins_site = substr(seq, 7,8),
         TA_site = ins_site == "TA") %>%
  group_by(TA_site) %>%
  summarize(av_read_count = mean(read_count),
            av_read_count_1 = mean(read_count_1),
            av_read_count_2 = mean(read_count_2),
            av_mapq= mean(mapq))
  
tib_seq_by_map %>%
  mutate(ins_site = substr(seq, 7,8),
         TA_site = ins_site == "TA") %>%
  group_by(ins_site) %>%
  summarize(av_read_count = mean(read_count),
            av_read_count_1 = mean(read_count_1),
            av_read_count_2 = mean(read_count_2),
            av_mapq= mean(mapq),
            N = n())
```
Non-TA sites are supported by slightly fewer reads and slightly lower mapping quality, but it does not look worrisome. I think most of these integrations are still real integrations. 


## frequency of motif in the mouse genome
I want to count how often each motif around TA occurs in the mouse genome. 
There is a problem that a single TA can be assigned to multiple windows of the motif, so instead of searching for the different motifs:
take all TA sites (actually take a random sample of 10 milion) in the genome and classify them:

```{r}
all_TA_sites <- vmatchPattern("TA", BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

all_TA_sites_std <-  keepStandardChromosomes(all_TA_sites, pruning.mode = 'coarse')
length(all_TA_sites_std)

#subsample 10 million TA sites
set.seed(20260409)
sample_TA_sites  = sample(all_TA_sites_std[strand(all_TA_sites_std) =="+" & seqnames(all_TA_sites_std) != "chrM"], #count each TA once & remove M chromosome
                          10E6, replace =F)

# Keep only TA with full ±3 context (avoid chromosome edges)
valid <- start(sample_TA_sites) > 3 & end(sample_TA_sites) <= seqlengths(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)[as.character(seqnames(sample_TA_sites))] - 3

sample_TA_sites <- sample_TA_sites[valid]

# Get sequences
contexts_TA <- getSeq(
  BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10,
  names = seqnames(sample_TA_sites),
  start = start(sample_TA_sites) - 3,
  end   = end(sample_TA_sites) + 3
)

# Classify surrounding sequences
ctx_char <- as.character(contexts_TA)
left_base  <- substr(ctx_char, 1, 1)
right_base <- substr(ctx_char, 8, 8)

category <- character(length(ctx_char))
category[left_base != "A" & right_base != "T"] <- "BNNTANNV"
category[left_base != "A" & right_base == "T"] <- "BNNTANNT"
category[left_base == "A" & right_base != "T"] <- "ANNTANNV"
category[left_base == "A" & right_base == "T"] <- "ANNTANNT"

table(category)
sum(category== "ANNTANNT")/length(category)
sum(category== "ANNTANNV")/length(category)
sum(category== "BNNTANNT")/length(category)
sum(category== "BNNTANNV")/length(category)


```
